value.rationale: The noncentral cube, omitted from recent shifted regular-polytope applications, is a canonical test family. The work supplies all-dimension exact expected vertex counts, a strict location law that requires a nontrivial n=3 inequality, an exact local Hessian coefficient and a uniform high-dimensional displacement law. This quantifies sensitivity to passing through noncentral points, rather than merely restating the known central expectation.
